description:
NinjaTrader 8 is open on the Windows desktop with the Control Center visible. Real daily OHLCV data for AAPL (Apple Inc.) from January 2023 to December 2024 (502 trading days from Yahoo Finance) is available in the NinjaTrader data directory.

Your task:
1. Open a new chart: from the Control Center menu, click 'New' then select 'Chart'.
2. In the chart creation dialog, select the instrument 'AAPL' with 'Daily' bars.
3. Click OK to create the chart.
4. Add the following indicators to the chart (right-click chart > Indicators):
   a. EMA (Exponential Moving Average) with Period = 50 — this should overlay on the price chart.
   b. RSI (Relative Strength Index) with Period = 14 — this should appear in a separate panel below the price chart.
   c. MACD with Fast = 12, Slow = 26, Smooth = 9 — this should appear in another separate panel below the RSI.
5. Save the workspace: File > Save Workspace.
